A NOTE FOR THE DAYS AHEAD01 / ∞

Dear future self,

May the doors you once prayed beside become the rooms where you serve with courage.

Ask God for the wisdom to carry what you are asking Him to give.

Keep your promises in the quiet. Do the work when nobody is watching.

When the room grows bigger, let your faith grow deeper. Use what you learn. Lift someone as you rise.

And through every answered prayer, remain a man God can still teach.

Walk boldly. Stay prayerful. Keep building.
